r0-context.title: Load baseline context
r0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus the handoff, the diff, and the relevant packet. Record pass when loaded.
r0-context.finding: Loaded reviewer doctrine, shared skill-goodness criteria, supplied handoff, working-tree diff, relevant role contracts, and installer registration maps; no local docs/agents overlays exist.

r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r1-handoff.finding: The six requested integration artifacts are present: new skill, plan, profile schema, installer bundles, registration/contract tests, and skill index; no unrelated tracked files were changed.

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside allowed scope and respect specific exclusions? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r2-scope.finding: Tracked changes stay within the requested skill registration and skill-definition scope. Existing untracked .claude/settings.local.json is unrelated and untouched.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r3-evidence.finding: Independently reproduced registration rail success and the specified test command: 71 tests and 248 subtests passed.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: The skill is registered with its required bundled engine/reference assets, is documented in the index, and includes focused registration/contract coverage. The appended checks assess the semantic and role-specific criteria.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if it is out of scope.
r5-reconciliation.finding: This adds a documented workflow skill but makes no architecture-map claim or architecture-significant code change; a Map Impact note is not required.

r6-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler code smells)
r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Render a verdict on each Fowler baseline smell (long method, large class, duplicated code, feature envy, data clumps, primitive obsession, long parameter list, shotgun surgery, divergent change, message chains, speculative generality, comments-as-deodorant): flagged / overridden / absent. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards — an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
constraints: Fowler smells are subordinate to documented repo standards; never hard violations
an override (smell not flagged because a standard wins) needs a logged reason
r6-fowler.finding: All twelve Fowler baseline smells are absent from this small declarative skill, installer-map, and focused-test diff; the completed pass record verifies.

r7-completion.title: Completion sharpness
r7-completion.imperative: Assess whether the skill defines a checkable terminal state and a single executable method.

r8-prose.title: Leading words and no-op/sediment
r8-prose.imperative: Assess whether the skill leads with operational imperatives and excludes unenforceable or duplicate prose.

r9-boundaries.title: Negative space and role boundaries
r9-boundaries.imperative: Assess clear exclusions and proper Explorer, Interrogator, Cartographer, Scout, Reviewer, and Triage role boundaries.

r10-inputs.title: Strict area-brief inputs
r10-inputs.imperative: Assess whether every required area-brief field is explicit, fail-fast, and operationally sufficient.

r11-repeatability.title: Area-by-area repeatability
r11-repeatability.imperative: Assess whether the profile and plan provide a repeatable, executable area-by-area cleanup process.
